7. Ongoing Management of VA and SCD Risk.1. Ischemic Heart Disease: Management recommendations for VA and SCD in patients with ischemic heart disease include therapies such as defibrillators and antiarrhythmic drugs.
7. Ongoing Management of VA and SCD Risk.2. Secondary Prevention of SCD in Patien: Implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) therapy is recommended for secondary prevention. Various studies, including those by Connolly et al., support the effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of ICDs compared to antiarrhythmic drugs like amiodarone.
